question: In November 2025, Narendra Modi inaugurated 'Shanti Shikhar', a modern centre for spiritual learning, peace, and meditation of the Brahma Kumaris at Nava Raipur in which Indian state?
solution:
p>The correct answer is __**Chhattisgarh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Prime Minister **Narendra Modi** inaugurated the **'Shanti Shikhar'** centre in **November 2025**, marking a significant milestone in the spiritual infrastructure of Central India.
 
• The centre is located in **Nava Raipur**, which serves as the planned administrative capital of the state of **Chhattisgarh**.
 
• **Shanti Shikhar** is designed as a modern facility dedicated to **spiritual learning**, **peace**, and **meditation**, aimed at fostering mental well-being and social harmony.
 
• The establishment of this centre is an initiative by the **Brahma Kumaris**, a prominent global spiritual movement that focuses on personal transformation and world renewal.
 
• The inauguration highlights the government's support for institutions that promote **holistic health** and **value-based education** within the country.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Brahma Kumaris World Spiritual University:**
 
 
• It is an international non-governmental spiritual organization founded by **Lekhraj Kripalani** (known as Brahma Baba) in **1936**.
 
• The organization is headquartered in **Mount Abu**, **Rajasthan**, India.
 
• It is known for its focus on **Raja Yoga** meditation and is one of the largest spiritual organizations in the world led primarily by women.
 
 
 
• **Nava Raipur (Atal Nagar):**
 
 
• It is India's first **greenfield smart city** and the fourth planned capital city in the country after Chandigarh, Gandhinagar, and Bhubaneswar.
 
• In **2018**, the city was renamed **Atal Nagar** in honor of the former Prime Minister **Atal Bihari Vajpayee**.
 
• The city is designed with a focus on **sustainability**, featuring integrated infrastructure and a large percentage of green cover.
 
 
 
• **State of Chhattisgarh:**
 
 
• **Chhattisgarh** was formed on **1st November 2000**, by partitioning the sixteen Chhattisgarhi-speaking districts of **Madhya Pradesh**.
 
• It is often referred to as the **"Rice Bowl of India"** due to its high rice production and the variety of rice species grown in the region.
 
• The state is rich in mineral resources, including **coal**, **iron ore**, and **bauxite**, contributing significantly to India's industrial sector.
 
 
 
• **Spiritual Tourism and Wellness:**
 
 
• The inauguration of centers like **Shanti Shikhar** aligns with India's broader push to promote **spiritual tourism** and **wellness centers** as part of the **Swadesh Darshan** and **PRASHAD** schemes.
 
• Such centers attract both domestic and international visitors seeking **yoga**, **meditation**, and traditional Indian spiritual wisdom.
